dictionary.channel_boost_warning: Above 100% the signal is amplified: it may distort.
dictionary.channel_unavailable: Audio system unavailable on the server: {error}
dictionary.title: Microphone
dictionary.description: Listening, wake word and audio cleanup of {assistant} on this node
dictionary.notice_unpaired: This node is only discovered on the mesh: pair it from Nodes & Servers to manage its microphone.
dictionary.notice_paired: The node applies listening settings on next contact. The microphone is chosen on the device.
dictionary.wake_hint: Change it by choosing a new name for the assistant.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_hint: Keeps listening for the wake word.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_MODE_hint: Offline keeps everything on the server; online uses the cloud for more accuracy.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_MULTILANG_hint: When off it only listens to the main language.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_VOICEPRINT_ENFORCE_hint: Ignores TV and strangers: answers only household voices.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_AUTO_FOLLOWUP_hint: Seconds in which you can continue without repeating the name.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_MAX_GAIN_hint: How much the signal can be raised for distant speakers.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_TARGET_RMS_hint: Level the auto-leveller brings the voice to.
